{{Top|leg}}
An '''acrobat droid''' was any type of droid designed to entertain through acrobatics. These droids came at all sizes, but some of them were smaller than a [[Human/Legends|Human]] hand.<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] during his [[mission for the Amulet of Kalara]] [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi apprentice]] [[Ben Skywalker]] found them on display at central chamber of [[Tendrando Arms]] offices in [[Crossroutes Business Habitat]] on [[Drewwa]].<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Exile">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref>
